scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Ah, have you come to
retrieve the memories
lost to you? Yes, you
must be here for the
secrets of life that
were once yours...
scripts.translation:
[生物化學家]
啊，你是來找回遺失的記憶嗎？
沒錯，你一定是為了曾經掌握的生命奧秘而來...

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Close your eyes and
put your mind at rest.
We will return to your
past to recollect the
fragments of your lost
memories.
scripts.translation:
[生物化學家]
閉上雙眼，讓心神平靜下來。
我們將回到你的過去，重新拾起那些遺失的記憶碎片。

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
When you open your eyes,
you will clearly remember
the secret of life. You will
also remember the weight of
responsibility in using these
secrets for the right ends...
scripts.translation:
[生物化學家]
睜開眼時，你會清楚地記起生命的奧秘。
也會記起，將這些奧秘用於正道，是多麼重大的責任...

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Open your eyes...
Now that you have
remembered how to
create artificial life, I only
ask that you treat all of your
creations with respect.
scripts.translation:
[生物化學家]
睜開雙眼吧...
你已經記起如何創造人工生命。
我只希望你尊重自己創造的每一個生命。

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
If you wish to
retrieve your lost
memories, please
come back to me.
The secret to creating
life is no trifling thing...
scripts.translation:
[生物化學家]
若想找回遺失的記憶，就再來找我。
創造生命的奧秘，絕非兒戲...

[生物化學家]
恭喜。
向勇士們致敬！

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
It's strange that
someone like me is here.
But even someone skilled
in the ways of science
can manage to be a hero.
scripts.translation:
[生物化學家]
像我這樣的人出現在這裡，確實有些奇怪。
不過，精通科學的人，也能成為英雄。

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
In this instance,
it's not necessarily
the means I've used, but
the ends for which I've
fought that earned me
a place in Valhalla...
scripts.translation:
[生物化學家]
讓我在英靈殿佔有一席之地的，未必是所用的手段，而是我為之奮鬥的目標...

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Yes...
It's about time.
We need more geniuses
like you on Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[生物化學家]
是啊...時機已到。
米德加爾特需要更多你這樣的天才。

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Would you like to
become a Biochemist?
scripts.translation:
[生物化學家]
你願意成為生物化學家嗎？

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[生物化學家]
準備好了，隨時回來吧。
向勇士們致敬！

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[生物化學家]
你還有可以學習的技能。
請用完剩餘的技能點，再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Congratulations!
As a Biochemist,
I hope you use your
vast knowledge for the
right purposes.
scripts.translation:
[生物化學家]
恭喜！
願你身為生物化學家，將淵博的知識用於正道。

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[生物化學家]
歡迎來到榮耀之廳——英靈殿。

scripts.text:
[Biochemist]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[生物化學家]
在這裡安心休息吧。
向勇士們致敬！
